body:
Staff (your 4 keeps, 1 Nov): Nurse Penny (lobby desk), Dr. Rūta (the vet), Vet nurse Leo (treat), Dr. Tomas (also works there).

NURSE PENNY (lobby desk)
Hello: "Hi! Welcome to the vet station. How can I help?"
Book a time (pet sick): "Come back between {time} and {time+2}. Dr. Rūta will see you!"
Book, no pet sick: "Your pets look healthy! No need for a visit."
Free tip (any pet): "{Pet} loves {favourite}. Try it today!" / "{Pet} looks a bit bored. A toy would help!" / "{Pet} is very happy. Great job!"
Too early: "Dr. Rūta is busy. Please wait here. Your time is {time}."
Missed the time: "You missed your time. Let's book a new one!"
Pay: "That's {coins} coins for {n} pets, please." / can't pay: "Don't worry, it's free today."

DR. RŪTA (exam room)
Start: "Hello, {Pet}! Let's have a look."
Checks (in order): "Ears... fine." → "Teeth... fine." → "Ah, a little cold."
More than one sick pet: "Next one! Hello, {Pet}!"

VET NURSE LEO (exam room, after the check)
Treat: "Here's a treat for being brave!" (pet is cured)
Reminder: "Don't let {Pet} get sad. Play, cuddles, toys every day!"

DR. TOMAS (walks around the station; tap him)
Random (never twice in a row): "Happy pets are healthy pets." / "Toys at home help when you're away." / "A sneeze means: play with me more!"

Rules used: rules-vet-visit (Penny books, Rūta checks, Leo treat + reminder, pay per pet, free if you can't pay), rules-mech-nurse-tip. Price: Schedules and economy chat.

comments.text: Done: Dr. Fern → Dr. Rūta; Leo gives the treat, Tomas has small talk (your 4 keeps).

short: Penny books and tips; Dr. Rūta checks; Leo gives the treat
